LanguageData.LP_Boon_Fate.label: boon of fate
LanguageData.LP_Boon_Fate.description: Fate isn't done with you yet. A lethal hit downs you instead: the lethal part is restored and wounds stop bleeding. Works once every 60 days.
LanguageData.LP_Boon_Immortal.label: boon of immortality
LanguageData.LP_Boon_Immortal.description: Time flows around you: no longer ages after adulthood, immune to disease.
LanguageData.LP_Boon_Might.label: boon of might
LanguageData.LP_Boon_Might.description: +4 to one ability score of your choice, and its cap rises to 24 (a demigod's cap bonus is counted separately).
LanguageData.LP_Boon_Speed.label: boon of speed
LanguageData.LP_Boon_Psyche.label: boon of the mind
LanguageData.LP_Boon_Combat.label: boon of combat
LanguageData.LP_Boon_Combat.description: Each time you down or kill an enemy, every wound on yourself heals 5% of that part's health.
LanguageData.LP_Boon_Resistance.label: boon of energy resistance
LanguageData.LP_Boon_Resistance.description: Fire, cold, lightning, acid, radiant and necrotic damage halved.
LanguageData.LP_Boon_Recovery.label: boon of recovery
LanguageData.LP_Boon_Recovery.description: The first time each day total injuries exceed 30, half of the wounds heal at once and bleeding stops; otherwise heals 1 extra point of injury every 250 ticks.
LanguageData.LP_Boon_Offense.label: boon of irresistible offense
LanguageData.LP_Boon_Offense.description: Weapon attacks gain +50% armor penetration; melee damage ×1.1.
LanguageData.LP_Boon_SpellRecall.label: boon of spell recall
